title: How a Wind Turbine Works in 60 Seconds 🌬️⚡ #shorts
description:
A wind turbine is a fan in reverse. Wing-shaped blades turn slowly with huge force, a gearbox speeds the rotation up, and a generator turns it into electricity while sensors keep the turbine facing the wind. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#windturbine #howitworks #shorts

steps.label: The Secret
steps.text: A wind turbine is basically a *fan in reverse*. Wind spins it, and it makes electricity.

steps.label: Blades
steps.text: The blades are shaped like *airplane wings*. Moving air creates lift that turns the rotor.

steps.label: Slow Spin
steps.text: The giant rotor turns *slowly*, but with enormous force.

steps.label: Gearbox
steps.text: Inside the nacelle, a *gearbox* speeds the spin up to well over a thousand RPM.

steps.label: Generator
steps.text: The fast shaft spins a *generator*, where magnets and copper coils create electricity.

steps.label: Control
steps.text: Sensors turn the turbine *into the wind* and tilt the blades to control the speed.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Wind, lift, gears, *power*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
